dedupe_keys.name: italian and south tyrolean industrial site level energy and emissions databases 2022 top down disaggregation

description: These two companion Zenodo databases give energy consumption and emissions for industrial sites in Italy and in South Tyrol for 2022, built with a top-down method that bridges national statistics and site-level data (data paper "Bridging the industrial data gap"). The records say each site has consumption by seven energy carriers (solid fossil fuels, manufactured gases, oil products, natural gas, biofuels, non-renewable wastes and electricity), process heat split into four temperature bands, process emissions from feedstock in hard-to-abate sectors, coordinates and region, and ATECO 2007 and Eurostat energy balance sector codes, integrating the EU ETS database, Eurostat energy balances, JRC-IDEES and municipal geography. The Italian database (version of 13 May 2025) is an Excel file of about 2.0 MB with summary tables, by authors from Politecnico di Milano, Accademia Europea, Eurac Research and Alperia; the South Tyrolean one (13 January 2026) is about 8.7 MB with a slide deck. Both are free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Italy and the province of South Tyrol. Caveats: values are disaggregated estimates, and the South Tyrol file gives locations by industrial class, not by named plant. For simulation they give located industrial energy demand to model grid, gas and heat supply to industry and decarbonisation options. Related catalogue records include IndustryHeat-EU and the Hotmaps industrial sites.
